newsitem.title: GREECE: Sigma still leads Greek brokers in Sept turnover.
newsitem.headline: Sigma still leads Greek brokers in Sept turnover.

text.p: Sigma Securities led Greek brokers in September market share with 8.77 percent of the bourse's turnover followed closely by National Securities with 8.14 percent, the Athens stock exchange association of member brokers (SMEHA) said.

N.D. Devletoglou was in third palce with 6.26 percent and Kappa Securities which launched opearation in late April advanced one notch to the fourth place with 4.83 percent. Alpha Brokerage was in fifth with 4.55 percent.

Euroxx was holding sixth place by improving its market share to 4.25 percent from 3.88 percent in August. Telesis was also steady in seventh place with 3.71 percent traced by Aspis Brokerage with 3.54 percent. Nuntius Securities undertook Omega in the ninth posision with 2.69 percent versus 2.52 percent.

Trading volume in September rose to 382.778 billion drachmas from 288.60 billion in August with January remaining the bourse's best month with 428.8 billion drachmas and may the worst with 209 billion.
Cumulative January-September turnover reached 2.624 trillion drachmas, SMEHA said.
